Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (48g), Fiber (2g), Calcium, Vit A
Ingredients Required: Pastry flour, Butter, Sugar, Yeast, Milk, Apricot jam / Nutella, Espresso beans, Whole milk for froth
Recipe Instructions: 1. Prepare laminated croissant dough with butter layers, cut into triangles, fill with jam or chocolate, and roll into crescent shapes (Cornetto). 2. Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 15-18 mins until flaky golden brown. 3. Brew fresh espresso shot and pour steamed, frothed hot milk over it.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (36g), Fiber (4g), Vit C, Lycopene
Ingredients Required: Italian Ciabatta bread / Sourdough (eggless/yeast-safe), Ripe San Marzano tomatoes, Fresh Basil, Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Dried Oregano, Sea salt, Black pepper
Recipe Instructions: 1. Slice bread and toast on grill or pan with olive oil until crisp. 2. Finely dice ripe tomatoes; toss with hand-torn fresh basil, extra virgin olive oil, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper (strictly no garlic or onion). 3. Spoon tomato mixture over hot toasted bread.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (30g), Fiber (8g), Healthy Fats, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Crusty Italian bread, Ripe avocado, Cherry tomatoes, Extra virgin olive oil, Balsamic glaze, Basil leaves, Sea salt, Flaky red pepper flakes
Recipe Instructions: 1. Toast thick crusty bread slices. 2. Mash ripe avocado with sea salt, lemon juice, and red pepper flakes. 3. Spread mash over toast, top with halved cherry tomatoes, fresh basil, and a drizzle of aged balsamic glaze.

Key Nutrients: Protein (26g), Fat (30g), Carbohydrates (4g), Fiber (1g), Calcium, Vit B12
Ingredients Required: Fresh eggs, Prosciutto di Parma, Parmigiano-Reggiano (aged Parmesan), Extra virgin olive oil, Fresh spinach, Black pepper, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Whisk eggs with grated Parmigiano-Reggiano and black pepper. 2. Sauté fresh spinach in an oven-safe skillet with olive oil until wilted; add torn Prosciutto strips. 3. Pour egg mixture over, cook on stovetop for 5 mins until edges set, then transfer under oven broiler for 5 mins till golden puffed.

Key Nutrients: Protein (10g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (62g), Fiber (4g), Calcium, Niacin
Ingredients Required: Arborio / Carnaroli rice, Porcini & Cremini mushrooms, Vegetable stock, Shallots, Garlic, Dry white wine, Butter, Parmigiano-Reggiano, Extra virgin olive oil, Parsley
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté sliced mushrooms in olive oil and set aside. 2. Sauté shallots and garlic; add Arborio rice and toast grains. Deglaze with white wine. 3. Add hot stock one ladle at a time while stirring constantly until creamy. Fold in mushrooms, butter, grated Parmigiano, and parsley.

Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (46g), Fiber (4g), Healthy Monounsaturated Fats, Vit A
Ingredients Required: Penne / Fusilli pasta (eggless), Fresh Basil leaves, Roasted Pine nuts (Pinoli), Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Vegetarian hard cheese / Mozzarella, Black pepper, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Blend fresh basil, toasted pine nuts, extra virgin olive oil, salt, and pepper into a bright green pesto (no garlic/cheese with animal rennet). 2. Boil pasta in salted water till al dente. 3. Toss hot drained pasta with pesto sauce and top with grated vegetarian cheese.

Key Nutrients: Protein (11g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (58g), Fiber (5g), Lycopene, Vit C
Ingredients Required: Spaghetti pasta, San Marzano canned plum tomatoes, Garlic cloves, Extra virgin olive oil, Fresh basil, Red pepper flakes, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté sliced garlic and red pepper flakes in extra virgin olive oil until fragrant. 2. Crush San Marzano tomatoes into the pan, season with salt, and simmer for 20 minutes until oil separates. 3. Toss al dente spaghetti in sauce with fresh torn basil leaves.

Key Nutrients: Protein (28g), Fat (28g), Carbohydrates (54g), Fiber (2g), Iron, Vit B12
Ingredients Required: Spaghetti pasta, Guanciale (cured pork cheek) or Pancetta, Egg yolks + Whole egg, Pecorino Romano cheese, Freshly cracked black pepper
Recipe Instructions: 1. Fry diced guanciale in a skillet until crispy; reserve rendered fat. 2. Whisk egg yolks, whole egg, grated Pecorino Romano, and black pepper. 3. Cook spaghetti al dente, toss immediately in skillet off heat with crispy guanciale, rendered fat, and egg-cheese mixture with starchy pasta water to form a silky creamy sauce.

Key Nutrients: Protein (11g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (38g), Fiber (2g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Leftover saffron Risotto rice, Mozzarella cheese cubes, Peas, Breadcrumbs, Flour, Milk/Egg slurry, Frying oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Take a portion of cooled risotto, stuff center with a cube of mozzarella and cooked peas, roll into a tight ball. 2. Coat balls in flour, dip in milk/egg slurry, and roll in breadcrumbs. 3. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown and crispy on the outside with melted cheese center.

Key Nutrients: Protein (9g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (6g), Fiber (1g), Calcium, Vit A
Ingredients Required: Bocconcini (Fresh Mozzarella balls), Cherry tomatoes, Fresh Basil leaves, Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Aged Balsamic glaze, Sea salt, Cracked black pepper, Wooden skewers
Recipe Instructions: 1. Thread cherry tomato, fresh basil leaf, and fresh mozzarella ball onto skewers. 2. Arrange on serving plate. 3. Drizzle generously with extra virgin olive oil, thick aged balsamic glaze, sea salt, and black pepper.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (38g), Fiber (3g), Iron, Healthy Fats
Ingredients Required: High-protein bread flour, Yeast, Water, Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Fresh Rosemary, Black & Green Olives, Flaky Sea Salt (Maldon)
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead high-hydration yeast dough with olive oil; let proof in tray until bubbly. 2. Dimple dough deeply with fingertips, pour generous extra virgin olive oil over top. 3. Press in olives, fresh rosemary sprigs, and flaky sea salt. Bake at 220°C (425°F) for 20 mins till golden crusty.

Dish Name: Fritto Misto di Mare (Crispy Fried Seafood)
Key Nutrients: Protein (26g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (30g), Fiber (2g), Omega-3, Selenium
Ingredients Required: Calimari rings, Shrimp, Small whitebait fish, Semolina flour (Rimacinata), All-purpose flour, Sparkling water, Lemon wedges, Aioli / Tartar sauce, Oil for frying
Recipe Instructions: 1. Clean and dry seafood pieces. Toss in a 50/50 mix of semolina flour and all-purpose flour seasoned with salt. 2. Flash fry in scorching hot oil for 2-3 minutes until ultra-crisp and golden. 3. Drain on paper towels, sprinkle sea salt, and serve hot with fresh lemon wedges.

Key Nutrients: Protein (20g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (64g), Fiber (4g), Calcium, Lycopene
Ingredients Required: Tipo 00 Flour, Yeast, San Marzano tomato sauce, Fresh Mozzarella (Fior di Latte), Fresh Basil leaves, Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Prepare long-fermentation Neapolitan pizza dough; stretch into thin round disc with raised crust edges (cornicione). 2. Spread crushed San Marzano tomato sauce, tear fresh mozzarella pieces, and drizzle extra virgin olive oil. 3. Bake in ultra-hot wood-fired oven (or 250°C+ oven steel) for 60-90 seconds. Garnish with basil.

Key Nutrients: Protein (18g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (62g), Fiber (5g), Calcium, Vit C
Ingredients Required: Eggless pizza dough, San Marzano tomato sauce, Fresh Mozzarella, Bell peppers (Red, Yellow, Green), Sweet corn, Zucchini, Dried Oregano, Extra Virgin Olive Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Stretch pizza dough; spread seasoned tomato sauce (no garlic or onion). 2. Top with diced bell peppers, sweet corn, sliced zucchini, and torn fresh mozzarella. 3. Bake at maximum oven temperature until crust charring appears; drizzle olive oil and oregano.

Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (9g), Carbohydrates (68g), Fiber (6g), Potassium, Vit C
Ingredients Required: Russet potatoes, All-purpose flour, San Marzano tomato sauce, Olive oil, Garlic, Fresh Basil, Sea salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Bake potatoes, peel, and pass through ricer; combine with flour and salt into soft dough (egg-free). 2. Roll into ropes, cut into pillow gnocchi shapes, simmer in boiling water till they float. 3. Toss immediately in garlic-infused San Marzano tomato sauce and fresh basil.

Key Nutrients: Protein (44g), Fat (36g), Carbohydrates (32g), Fiber (3g), Iron, Zinc, Vit B12
Ingredients Required: Cross-cut Veal shanks, Flour, Butter, Onions, Carrots, Celery, Dry white wine, Beef stock, Tomatoes, Lemon zest, Garlic, Parsley (Gremolata), Saffron Risotto
Recipe Instructions: 1. Dredge veal shanks in flour and sear in butter till brown. 2. Sauté mirepoix (onion, carrot, celery); deglaze with white wine, add stock and tomatoes. Braise veal covered for 2 hours until tender. 3. Top with fresh lemon zest, garlic, and parsley (Gremolata); serve over Saffron Risotto.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (24g), Carbohydrates (42g), Fiber (1g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Savoiardi (Ladyfingers), Mascarpone cheese, Egg yolks, Sugar, Strong brewed Espresso coffee, Dark Cocoa powder, Rum / Kahlua (optional)
Recipe Instructions: 1. Whisk egg yolks and sugar over double boiler until thick, then fold into room-temperature Mascarpone cheese. 2. Dip ladyfinger biscuits briefly into cold brewed espresso. 3. Layer soaked biscuits and mascarpone cream in dish; chill for 6 hours. Dust heavily with dark cocoa powder before serving.

Key Nutrients: Protein (4g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (34g), Fiber (1g), Calcium, Vit A
Ingredients Required: Heavy Cream, Whole Milk, Sugar, Vanilla extract, Agar-agar powder (plant-based gel setting), Mango puree, Mint leaves
Recipe Instructions: 1. Heat cream, milk, sugar, and agar-agar powder until boiling; stir in vanilla extract. 2. Pour into glasses and set in refrigerator for 3 hours. 3. Top with fresh sweet Alphonso mango puree glaze and a mint leaf.

Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (42g), Fiber (1g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Flour, Cocoa powder, Marsala wine, Butter, Sheep's milk Ricotta cheese, Powdered sugar, Candied orange peel, Dark chocolate chips, Pistachios
Recipe Instructions: 1. Prepare pastry dough with flour, butter, and Marsala wine; wrap around steel cylinders and deep fry until crispy and blistered. 2. Whisk fresh ricotta with powdered sugar, chocolate chips, and candied orange peel. 3. Pipe ricotta filling into cooled shells right before serving; dip ends in chopped pistachios.

Dish Name: Vegan Gelato al Cioccolato (Dark Chocolate Gelato)
Key Nutrients: Protein (4g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (32g), Fiber (4g), Iron, Magnesium
Ingredients Required: Oat milk / Almond milk, Dark Dutch cocoa powder, 70% Dark vegan chocolate, Sugar, Dextrose, Locust bean gum / Tapioca starch, Sea salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Heat oat milk, cocoa powder, dark chocolate, sugar, and tapioca starch until melted and thickened. 2. Chill base mixture in ice bath for 4 hours. 3. Churn in an ice cream maker until dense and smooth gelato texture forms. Freeze briefly before scooping.
